name: odoo-mcp-server
description: Give Claude safe local access to your Odoo CRM and projects so it can search records, review context, draft approved updates, and log internal notes, while blocking deletes and external messages.

odoo_transport.title: Odoo transport
odoo_transport.description: Choose xmlrpc for Odoo 18 and below, or json2 for Odoo 19 and above.

enable_writes.title: Enable writes to Odoo
enable_writes.description: Allow approved create/update operations to execute against Odoo. When off, the server is read-only and write tools fail closed. Every write still requires explicit in-conversation approval. Restart the extension after changing this.

enable_self_update.title: Enable self-update
enable_self_update.description: Allow the server to update its own code from GitHub when you approve an update in conversation. When off, update checks still work but applying an update is blocked. Restart the extension after changing this.
